DOP: ubbega m. and mfn. [ S. udvega], 1. ( m. ) agitation; alarm; anxiety; shrinking from, shying away from ; D III 148, 1 (~aṃ uttāsaṃ bhayaṃ apanuditā; Sv 923, 20 : vilumpanabandhanādinissayaṃ bhayaṃ ~o nāma); Ja V 81, 21* (tāvanto tassa ~ā); Nidd I 371, 13 (lomahaṃso cetaso ~o utrāso; cf Nidd-a I 395, 21 : ~o ti bhīruko, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce turito utrāso); Vism 464, 32 (ottappaṃ, pāpato ~ass’ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ); Sp 565, 9 (ubbijjantī ti kinnu āharāpessantī ti ~aṃ iñjanaṃ calanaṃ paṭilabhanti); Sadd 404, 23 (~o utrāso bhīrutā); — ifc see ubbijjanakabhay’-; — 2. ( mfn. ) shaking; springing upwards, uplifting ; Vism 143, 21 (~ā pīti balavatī hoti, kāyaṃ uddhaggaṃ katvā ākāse laṅghāpanappamāṇappattā); Paṭis-a 589, 34 (~ā pīti); — °- uttāsa-bhayāpanūdana , mfn. , driving away alarm and fear ; D III 148, 26* ; — °- va(t) , mfn. , anxious, full of alarm ; Ja III 313, 15´ .
CPD: ubbega , m. [ sa. udvega], anguish, excitement, fear; Sadd 404, 23 ; 479, 16 ; ~aṃ uttāsaṃ bhayaṃ apanuditā, D lll 148, 1 (°-bhayaṃ c' eva uttāsa- bhayañ ca. tattha corato vā rājato vā paccatthikato vā vilumpana-bandhanâdi-nissayaṃ bhayaṃ ~o nāma, Sv 923, 18 ); tāvanto tassa ~o, Ja V 81, 21* = Vl 388, 28* ; cetaso ~o utrāso, Nidd l 371, 13 (= bhī- ruko, Nidd-a l 395, 21 ); saṃvegaṃ ~aṃ utrāsaṃ . . . kittayissāmi, Nidd l 406, 14 (= ṭhitaṭṭhānato gama- naṃ, Nidd-a l 426, 27 ); ubbijjantī ti . . . ~aṃ iñjanaṃ calanaṃ paṭilabhanti, Sp 565, 9 ; (ottappaṃ) pāpato ~ass' etaṃ adhivacanaṃ, As 124, 33 = Abhid-av 19, 30 ; — in a long cpd. at D lll 148, 26* ; — ifc. ubbijjanaka- ° (Ud-a 163, 2 ); — ° -jāta , mfn., being excited; ~ā sumanā tuṭṭhahaṭṭhā āsiṃsu te, Ap 412, 2 ; — ° -ppatta , mfn ., frightened; ghaṭṭetvā vijjhitvā ~aṃ karoti, Mp lll 119, 26 = Pp-a 226, 25 ; ~ā hutvā, Ja l 69, 14 ; — ° -bahula , mfn., full of fear; sabba-saṅkhāresu ~o hoti uttāsabahulo, Paṭis ll 201, 23 (ñāṇabhayavasena bhaya-bahulo, Paṭis-a 653, 5 ) qu. Ps lV 85, 25 (= abhiṇhaṃ pavatta-saṃvego, pṭ B e 1961 274, 2 ) and Spk l 122, 22 .

[ cf S. udvijate], is agitated, shudders with alarm; is afraid of (usually + gen.); shrinks from, shies away from ; Vin III 144, 33 (manussā … ~anti pi uttasanti pi palāyanti pi); Nett 12, 15 (sabbe sattā dukkhassa ~anti); Mil 149, 5 (etthāyaṃ jano tasati ca ~ati ca); Cp-a 260, 25 (koci satto maṃ na uttasati na ~eti, eds so ); — aor. 3 sg. ubbijji, ubbiji, S I 228, 3 (~i, Be, Ee so; Ce, Se ~ati); Mil 286, 4 (bhiyyosomattāya ~i samvijji, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ubbiji saṃviji); Ja VI 78, 30* (migo … taṃ disvā ~i Sāma tena kodho mam āvisi, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be ubbijī); 3 pl. ubbijjiṃsu, Ja II 282, 20 ; Ap 411, 20 ( Be, Ce, Ee so; Se vimhayiṃsu); — absol. ubbijjitvā, Vism 58, 21 (sīlavipattito ~itvā); — pp ubbigga , mfn.
